contract.intended_consumer: Brian and his coding agents starting or continuing governed project work
contract.outcome: A coding agent cannot select another classed project outcome until a deliberate Project Graph-bound portfolio allocation exists.

canonical_journey.starting_state: The exact Plan 120 claim has a classed outcome scenario but the portfolio ledger has no active allocation.
canonical_journey.input: One immutable maintenance allocation request and the exact reviewed Project Graph Git revision.
canonical_journey.action: Reject unallocated selection, allocate and replay the slot, select it, observe selected pre-write, then park it.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Selection retains the exact active allocation digest and parking invalidates later resolution without deleting history.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Selection self-allocates, accepts a caller-chosen owner, overbooks a WIP bucket, rewrites replay, or survives disposition.
